data.title: Get from Nautobot
data.overview: Select devices from the Nautobot inventory.
data.description: Select one or more target devices from the inventory.

data.title: Get Nautobot Attributes
data.overview: Retrieve Nautobot attributes for selected devices.
data.description: Retrieve attributes from Nautobot for selected devices.

data.title: Run Command
data.overview: Execute CLI commands on connected devices.
data.description: Execute one or more CLI commands on connected devices.

data.title: Get Configs
data.overview: Get device configuration in the chosen format.
data.description: Get device configuration in the specified format.

data.title: Parse Cisco Config
data.overview: Parse a Cisco running/startup config into structured data.
data.description: Parse a Cisco IOS/IOS-XE/NXOS/XR running and/or startup configuration into structured data (hostname, VRFs, VLANs, interfaces, ACLs, routing, etc.) using cisco-config-parser, for use by Jinja templates and Log Attributes.

data.title: Render Jinja Template
data.overview: Render a Jinja2 template per device.
data.description: Render a Jinja2 template per device and store the result for downstream steps.

data.title: Deploy rendered Template
data.overview: Push a rendered template's commands to connected devices.
data.description: Execute the commands produced by a Render Jinja Template step on connected devices, optionally saving the running configuration afterward.

data.title: Notify Success
data.overview: Post a message to a Mattermost channel.
data.description: Posts one message to a Mattermost channel via a configured Mattermost source, team, and channel. Supports {path.to.value} placeholders resolved against the first device in context (e.g. {device.name}, {nautobot.location.name}), plus {devices} (comma-joined device names) and {device_count} for summarizing a multi-device run. Typically wired to an upstream step's success or failure outcome handle to report a workflow's outcome. Fan-out note: place after Fan In (or at the end of a non-fanned workflow) for one summary message per run; inside fan-out children it posts once per child branch.
